description_en: Restarts a specified instance. After the restart, the instance enters the activating state
description_zh: 重启指定实例。重启后，实例会进入生效中（activing）状态
kebab_example: aliyun elasticsearch restart-logstash --instance-id ls-cn-v0h1kzca0000 --biz-force true --client-token 5A2CFF0E-5718-45B5-9D4D-70B3FF0000 --batch-count 20.0 --restart-type instance --nodes 192.168.1.1 --node-types kibana --blue-green-dep false --api-version 2017-06-13 --region cn-hangzhou
name: RestartLogstash

parameters.description_en:
Specifies whether to forcefully restart the instance. Valid values:

- true: forcefully restarts the instance.
- false (default): does not forcefully restart the instance.
parameters.description_zh:
是否强制重启：

- true：强制，
- false（默认）：不强制

parameters.description_en: A client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. The value is generated by the client and must be unique among different requests. The maximum length is 64 ASCII characters.
parameters.description_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大不超过64个ASCII字符。
